# mixed-cs-vb-sln

Original synthetic code written for this repository. It contains no third-party code or assets and is released under the repository license.

## Purpose

A solution with a C# XNA 4.0 game and a Visual Basic XNA 4.0 library that the game references. Both projects are XNA projects. It is never built.

## What the analyzer should find

- Two projects: `Game/Game.csproj` (C#) and `Lib/Lib.vbproj` (Visual Basic), both XNA 4.0 on Windows.
- The Language column of the Markdown report appears because one project is Visual Basic.
